title: Encoder Quadrature Signal Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Explain how a quadrature encoder's two out-of-phase square-wave signals encode rotation, and differentiate clockwise from counter-clockwise rotation by examining which of the two signals changes first on each step.

learningObjectives: Explain how a quadrature encoder's two out-of-phase square-wave signals encode rotation, and differentiate clockwise from counter-clockwise rotation by examining which of the two signals changes first on each step.
